name: Products
admission_gate: A product definition exists whether or not any batch is being made.
It survives discontinuation as the record of what was made and sold.
Technical, quality and supply chain roles name products every day.

name: Instances
admission_gate: An individually identified unit — a serialised pack or a machine — exists apart from the organisation that made or owns it.
Its record survives disposal as a history of repairs, failures and recalls.
A maintenance lead and a recall coordinator name units every day.

name: Equipment
admission_gate: A place in the plant exists independently of the machine standing in it.
It survives the replacement of that machine.
A plant manager names lines, cells and units every day.

name: Processes
admission_gate: A step of work is defined once, independently of any product using it.
It survives the discontinuation of any product using it.
Technical and plant roles name steps — pasteurising, filling — every day.

name: Locations
admission_gate: A site or warehouse exists independently of what is stored in it.
It survives closure as the place history refers to.
Supply chain and quality roles name sites and stores every day.
